audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Yorick's W and E swapped. It calls E a 'mist-cage' that traps you and calls W 'ghoul-walls' that shield him. Riot's kit: Dark Procession (W) is the destructible wall that blocks movement, 20/18/16/14/12s; Mourning Mist (E) is a thrown globule that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks you, and summoned units gain move speed toward the marked target.
audit.why: This is the calibration-class error. A player told the cage is on E will bait the wrong cooldown, walk into the actual wall, and never learn that Mourning Mist's mark is what turns the ghoul swarm onto him.
audit.corrected: W Dark Procession is the cage (20s at rank 1, and destructible); E Mourning Mist is the armour-shred slow that marks you for the ghouls (12s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] claim Ragnarok 'removes his E mist-cage and W wall'. Ragnarok's text grants immunity to disables — it says nothing about deleting terrain, and Dark Procession is terrain.
audit.why: Telling a player his ultimate erases a wall will get him killed inside one. What is verifiable is better anyway: Riot calls the wall destructible, so he can break it.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok answers Mourning Mist's slow; the Dark Procession cage has to be broken or walked, not ulted away.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart marks Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 as Skill and awards Olaf the two-item row, while whys[0] says Olaf wins first contact outright, whys[3] says he out-trades a pre-Maiden Yorick, and whys[6] plus late say Yorick takes over at two items.
audit.why: On a 56.15% lane the early rows should read as Olaf's, and the only row Yorick owns is the one currently given away.
audit.corrected: Olaf Levels 1 through first item; Yorick at two-plus items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the packet reports his abilities are never named in the full layer.
audit.why: Dark Procession 20s at rank 1, Mourning Mist 12s, Eulogy of the Isles 160s at rank 1 — his Maiden spike is on a very long timer, which is exactly why the pre-6 and pre-item windows matter.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the Do's entry and the cooldown block.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is correctly listed — Last Rites heals him on a 6s cooldown.

edits.before: Yorick is slow and immobile at Levels 1-3 with no escape, which is exactly your meal. Land Q to slow him, walk up, and E for the chunk of guaranteed true damage — his ghoul-walls (W) and the graves only shield him once they're up, so hit him before he has ghouls stacked or Maiden out. Watch his E: if it lands the mist-slow and cage you, his autos and ghouls chunk you, so don't path through it — your passive attack speed only helps if you're actually on him, not stuck behind a wall.
edits.after: Yorick is slow and immobile at Levels 1-3 with no escape, which is exactly your meal. Land Undertow to slow him, walk up, and Reckless Swing for guaranteed true damage — hit him before graves turn into ghouls or Maiden exists. The ability to respect is Mourning Mist (E): it shreds your armour, slows you, and marks you so every ghoul sprints straight at you. Dark Procession is the cage, 20s at rank 1 and destructible — swing it down rather than walking the long way round.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep snowballing short trades — axe-reset Q perma-slows him so he can't walk out, and W omnivamp heals back whatever the ghouls poke off you. At 6 Ragnarok is the whole lane: it cleanses his E cage and removes the slow, so the moment he tries to zone you off the wave or wall you in, ult and run him down — he has zero CC to stop an unstoppable Olaf in melee. Bait his E mist before you commit; once it's down he's a sitting target with no peel.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you keep snowballing short trades — axe resets perma-slow him so he can't walk out, and W's shield eats whatever the ghouls poke off you. At 6 Ragnarok is the whole lane: it answers Mourning Mist's slow, so the moment he tries to zone you off the wave, ult and run him down — he has no hard CC to stop you in melee. Bait that E first; it is 12s at rank 1, and once it is gone the ghouls lose their mark and he is a sitting target.
